title: Silver tool preferences v1
description: Which transport to use for an activity, and what to do when it is not there. Authored personally in My Practice, or by a project or team. Ordering and prohibition are separate: `activities` states a preference order, `forbid` removes a transport from consideration entirely. A personal file uses `activities` only — forbidding is a project, team, or organization power.

activities.description: Keyed by activity id. The first source that binds an activity wins outright; later sources are not merged into it.

use.description: Transports in preference order. This is an offer list, not an auto-fallback list: when the first is unavailable, `on_unavailable` decides whether Silver may move down it.

on_unavailable.description: ask: report why and let the designer choose (default). use_next: move down the list and say so. stop: do not substitute.

forbid.description: Transports that may never be selected here, whatever anyone prefers. For constraints a designer cannot waive on their own, such as design files not transiting a third-party server.

fixable_by.description: Who can lift this. Carried into the removal record so a designer is told whether to fix it or who to ask.
